title: Gaming compact context (table row)
description: One row of research/gaming/compact-context.csv: a cited fact on compact negotiation, good-faith litigation, Secretarial Procedures, compact review rules, revenue sharing, or a state's negotiating authority and current talks (research/gaming/README.md). Built by scripts/gaming/build_context.py and scripts/gaming/check_quotes.py. Every cell is text and an empty cell is left out before checking, so 'required' means the cell may not be empty.

id.description: A word for the kind of fact and a three-digit number, for example litigation-001.

states.description: Two-letter codes of the states the fact concerns, separated by semicolons.

nations_as_named.description: The nations as the source names them.

citation.description: Indigo Book citation, when the source is a case, rule or notice.

source.description: Key of a source record in content/sources/ (scripts/validate_records.py checks it exists).

quote.description: The quotation a script looked for on the cited page.
